name: io.github.rubrikinc/rubrik-mcp
title: Rubrik Security Cloud
description: Connect AI assistants to the Rubrik Security Cloud GraphQL API to discover, query, and automate.

environmentVariables.name: RSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to an RSC service account JSON file. Optional: discovery tools work without credentials.

environmentVariables.name: RSC_URL
environmentVariables.description: RSC URL, e.g. https://example.my.rubrik.com. Alternative to a service account file.

environmentVariables.name: RSC_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Service account client ID. Use with RSC_URL and RSC_CLIENT_SECRET.

environmentVariables.name: RSC_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Service account client secret. Use with RSC_URL and RSC_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIK_MCP_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the gating policy and saved workflows. Defaults to ~/.config/rubrik-mcp.
